schema_file: question_schema_v7_file layer with locators stimuli rubric and provenance.json
procedure_file: extraction_procedure_social_addendum_v1.4_social science Classes 6-10 on top of procedure v2.md

second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (69 numbered keys + 1 unnumbered match block(s)) + 1 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side labels 1-71 monotonic, no gaps or duplicates; answer side 1-29, [match block], 31-70; q71 (draw) has no key. Difficulty per question: easy 50, average 3, difficult 17, untagged 1.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 7 (heading, LO) 8-11; A pdf 111 (heading, keys 1-15) 112-115.

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-10; s2 fill q11-19; s3 T/F q20-29; s4 '30.Match the Following' q30 (own numbered line; key unnumbered under 'Match the Following:'); s5 one mark q31-45 vsa; s6 two marks q46-52 sa; s7 three marks q53-61 sa; s8 four marks q62-71 la (heading tagged '(difficult)' -> section_header).
No section heading tag on s1-s7; stems carry their own tags except q6 'Types of Bees' (no tag printed -> null + 'no difficulty tag'). Match q30 prints '(Easy)' on every row -> printed Easy.
Keys: one-line prose keys stored verbatim (SINGLE), bullet keys one step per bullet; q53, q54, q58 wrapped prose joined.
q71 'Draw a picture of the bee hive and colour it.' — no key printed -> empty + 'no answer printed'.
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_02.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.
